hook: His boat broke down, so he tried to swim for it.
narration: His sailboat broke down after Hurricane Helene, [short pause] so he tried to swim to shore.
A Coast Guard helicopter crew from Air Station Clearwater found him still in the water off Gulfport, Florida.
The rescue swimmer rode the cable down, and the crew sent the basket after him.
outcome: He was hoisted out and flown to safety, with no medical concerns.
title: He tried to swim to shore after Helene
description:
After his 32-foot sailboat became disabled near Gulfport, Florida, following Hurricane Helene, a man tried to swim ashore. A Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater helicopter crew hoisted him from the water on Sept. 27, 2024, with no reported medical concerns.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, courtesy Air Station Clearwater, edited by Petty Officer 3rd Class Santiago Gomez, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/938233

question_comment: Would you have tried to swim for it or stayed with the boat?

facts.claim: Tried to swim ashore when his sailboat became disabled near Gulfport
facts.source_quote: rescues a man from the water after he attempted to swim ashore when the 32-foot sailing vessel he was aboard became disabled near the City of Gulfport Municipal Marina
The man was hoisted and transported to Albert Whitted Airport with no reported medical concerns
